_comment: Model registry. `python -m forge models pull <name>` downloads into models/<dest>. commercial_ok is read from the model's licence; shipped game assets come only from commercial_ok models (docs/LICENSING.md). Verify a licence yourself before you ship — this table is a convenience, not legal advice.

sdxl-base-1.0.notes: The baseline. Use-based restrictions apply (no illegal/harmful content) but commercial use of weights and outputs is permitted.

flux2-klein-4b.notes: The only FLUX.2 model under Apache 2.0. File list depends on the ComfyUI packaging (unet + text encoder + VAE) — fill `files` from the model card, or download in ComfyUI's manager and point the workflow at it.

flux2-klein-9b.notes: Experiments only. Not for shipped assets.

qwen-image-edit-2509.notes: Reference-image editing (pose sheets with the Spritely LoRAs). ~20B params: fp8/GGUF + CPU offload on 16 GB VRAM.
